messages:
Anita: quick FYI — after we flipped v2-as-default in staging yesterday some dashboards showed a drop in 'tokens_generated' and a jump in 'generation_latency_p50'. looks like telemetry field names changed in v2. can we sync on compatibility strategy?
Joel: saw that too. v2 renamed event `generation` -> `gen_response` and moved `route_id` into metadata rather than top-level. dashboards/alerts are still wired to old names. :grimacing:
Maria: this will break customer-facing quota dashboards too — our per-route quota UI expects `route_id` at top-level. we should avoid a hard break for production.
Kevin: agree. v2 behavior is more structured (we added `meta.route.id`) but we didn't emit legacy keys. quick fix is dual-emitting both shapes for a grace period. performance cost is tiny.
Anita: propose a compatibility plan: 1) emit legacy telemetry fields (e.g., `generation`, `tokens_generated`, `route_id`) for 60 days; 2) add an `Accept-API-Version: v1-compatible` request header for customers that need old response shape; 3) console shows a banner + opt-out for orgs that want strict v2 only. thoughts?
Joel: +1 on dual emit. we also need to consider quotas: v2 changed the quota key resolution (now prefers `meta.route.id` then `route` header). if we dual emit, quota service must accept both keys for the deprecation window. who's owning that change?
Maria: infra/quota team needs a feature flag toggle. I can file an infra task but we should time it with canary rollout. suggested rollout: internal-only 5% -> external beta 20% -> full 100% after 30 days of telemetry stability.
Kevin: we must also update the runtime to keep backward semantics for streaming chunk envelopes. v2 updated the envelope to include `cursor` field which some integrators parse. we should add `cursor` but also keep `offset` for compatibility. add a small snippet to the compatibility layer: 
```
// emit both envelope shapes
emit({ event: 'gen_response', meta: { route: { id: r } }, tokens: t })
emit({ event: 'generation', route_id: r, tokens_generated: t })
```
Joel: for the API surface, instead of `Accept-API-Version` header I'd prefer a query param `compat=v1` for ease of SDKs that can't modify headers easily (mobile/web). but headers are more RESTy. open to either.
Maria: console UX: show per-organization toggle labeled "Legacy API shape (v1) compatibility" with clear expiry date + reason. also add a migration checklist link. UX will need a dev flag for testing.
Anita: on deprecation timeline: 60 days grace + 30 day warning before enforcement seems OK. so total 90 days from start to removal unless customers request extension. exceptions require support + security signoff.
Kevin: telemetry names: we should map old -> new in our event router so existing dashboards keep working. I'll add a compatibility map in the telemetry pipeline. also add an automated smoke test that validates key dashboards after every canary push.
Joel: one more gotcha: rate limiting keys. v2 started using `org_id` + `meta.route.id` as the key; v1 used `org_id` + `route`. Make sure RL service accepts both keys during grace. I'll open a PR to add fallback logic.
rollout-bot: deploy request queued: "compatibility/dual-emit" -> canary group: internal-devs (5%). ETA: 2025-10-03 18:00 UTC.
Maria: testing checklist (short): 
- smoke dashboards (tokens, latency)
- quota enforcement sanity tests
- SDK roundtrip tests for streaming envelopes
- e2e with two large customers in staging
I'll post the checklist doc in #eng-platform after this thread.
Anita: next actions: Joel + Kevin implement dual-emit + quota fallback PR this week, Maria adds console toggle mock by Tue, I'll draft deprecation notice to customers. schedule a sync Thu 10am to confirm readiness. @Joel @Kevin PTAL and ack if you got the plan.
Joel: ack. starting PR now.
Kevin: ack. will add telemetry mapper and envelope fallback today.
Maria: ack — will drop UI mock and link in here when ready.
Anita: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
